analysis: mean of three paired MAE reductions per episode, then average seeds within episode; stratified episode bootstrap by family; no process/seed/pair pseudoreplication
primary_comparison: native upstream/native downstream versus native upstream/shared FAR identity downstream positions, common post-RoPE reduction order
negative_control: different deterministic semantic-key shuffle in each history; same positions multiset and same reduction order
specificity_control: common shuffled semantic-key map in all histories; if all shared maps help equally, report nonspecific sensitivity suppression
positive_control: upstream temporal positions AND downstream identity positions clamped to FAR; equality is an engineering expectation, not bridge evidence
falsification: no positive mean episode reduction, inconsistent seeds/anchors, or reduction no larger than numerical execution effect leaves bridge unsupported
inference_claim: controlled intervention effect on action divergence, not a uniquely identified natural indirect effect or task success
no_retry: stop and preserve integrity failure; never retry valid negative; new version and output root for corrections
